description.p: A Ruby GTK4 port of GNOME Console. A simple, user-friendly terminal emulator for casual command-line work: tabs with an overview, search, link detection, drag-and-drop of files onto the prompt, light and dark themes, and header-bar tinting for root, remote and container sessions.
This is an independent port and is not affiliated with the GNOME project.
First release of the Ruby port.
